semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Forter Technology Corporation specializes in optoelectronic instruments and measurement systems relevant to the semiconductor industry, particularly in solar cell testing and silicon photonics.
summary: Forter Technology Corporation is a key player in the optics industry, providing a range of optoelectronic instruments and measurement systems that are essential for semiconductor applications. Their offerings include laser systems, optical components, and specialized measurement solutions for solar cells and silicon photonics.
capabilities: Solar cell IV and IPCE measurement systems
SiP (Silicon Photonics) alignment and measurement systems
Laser optical system integration and design

regional_presence.Taiwan: Forter Technology is the exclusive distributor for several international manufacturers in Taiwan.
